context_output_resource_limits.note: cpt_cells counts LLM-estimated percentage cells (roots 3+5+4+3+4+3+3+3+4=32 plus children 60x2+6x3+12x4+9x4+32x10=542). No silent truncation: if complete CPT output cannot fit, reject admission or fail clearly.

cpt_contract.row_order: child state fastest; last declared parent next; first parent slowest
cpt_contract.validation: one table per node in declared order; exact node/parent/state identity and order; no extra fields; finite numbers in [0,100]; each row sums to 100 within 1e-6; reject missing/duplicate/extra rows, strings/booleans/null, nonfinite, out-of-range, wrong sums; never normalize/clip/repair

output_catalog_binding.note: No reviewed drug catalog release exists (no content/ddi catalog; S18 pending). States below are the 9 repeat-dosing Table 7 LAI products in Table 7 order with PROVISIONAL identifiers for review. patient_mappings.missing_policy: partial diagnosis -> needs_clarification (blocks); bypassed or otherwise unavailable -> unknown_incomplete (permits inference with disclosure); never infer confirmation from symptom count alone
patient_mappings.typed_transform: confirmed iff diagnosis complete and threshold met; not_confirmed_assessed iff diagnosis complete and below threshold (after attributed acknowledgment) or bypassed-with-assessed-non-confirmation is recorded; else unknown_incomplete. Bypass without a threshold result is unknown, never confirmation.

patient_mappings.missing_policy: field absent/not_assessed -> unknown_incomplete with disclosure until reviewed and collected; conflicting values -> needs_clarification
patient_mappings.time_window: current encounter, after discussion of LAI pluses/minuses
patient_mappings.typed_transform: prefers_lai / prefers_oral / undecided / declines_lai per recorded informed preference; undecided is assessed ambivalence, not missing documentation; absence of documentation is unknown_incomplete, never oral preference and never consent.

patient_mappings.missing_policy: not_assessed/unknown/missing -> unknown_incomplete (permits inference with disclosure); conflicting values -> needs_clarification
patient_mappings.time_window: historical_interval (local window and criteria unresolved, owner Q4)
patient_mappings.typed_transform: adequate iff assessed adequate; poor iff assessed difficulty; uncertain iff assessed uncertainty (never an unreviewed chart); else unknown_incomplete. Never infer adequacy from missing documentation.

patient_mappings.missing_policy: field absent -> unknown_incomplete with disclosure until reviewed and collected
patient_mappings.typed_transform: present iff a clinician-identified contextual reason is recorded (oral nonresponse with possible gaps; care transition; early illness or awareness/substance-use concern; repeated hospitalizations/emergency visits); absent_assessed iff assessed and none identified; else unknown_incomplete. Context prompts discussion only and is never added to the formal indication.

allowed_source_paths: encounters.draft_data.medications (reconciled drug-only list, presence and identity only)
patient_mappings.missing_policy: unreviewed/missing -> unknown_incomplete (permits inference with disclosure); conflicting values -> needs_clarification
patient_mappings.time_window: historical_interval for oral experience; registration encounter for reconciliation
patient_mappings.typed_transform: evidence_supported iff same-candidate oral efficacy and tolerability both supported; concern_recorded iff either has a recorded concern (concern takes precedence); not_established iff reviewed and no supporting evidence; else unknown_incomplete. No dose, unit, route, frequency, duration, level, or active/stopped values are read: excluded by FR-14 and by design, never hidden fields.
present iff documented history; absent_assessed iff assessed absence; else unknown_incomplete. Never assesses current NMS and never replaces urgent medical assessment.

patient_mappings.missing_policy: attestation absent -> unknown_incomplete with disclosure until reviewed and collected
patient_mappings.typed_transform: yes iff clinician/pharmacist review of the candidate product plan against current labeling is documented (availability, switch need, conversion-table pointer, overlap/loading pointer, route/site/interval, preparation/storage, safe injection, observation/monitoring, missed-dose instructions); no iff explicitly not yet reviewed; else unknown_incomplete. yes means reviewed, never approved or suitable. No dose values stored.

patient_mappings.missing_policy: field absent -> unknown_incomplete with disclosure until reviewed and collected
patient_mappings.typed_transform: present iff any assessed access barrier recorded (transportation, scheduling, childcare, cost/authorization, staffing/training, space/resources); absent_assessed iff assessed and none identified; else unknown_incomplete. Absence of assessment is never evidence of suitability.

allowed_source_paths: encounters.draft_data.medications (reconciled drug-only list, LAI entries by drug identity only)
patient_mappings.missing_policy: unreconciled/missing medication history -> unknown_incomplete (permits inference with disclosure)
patient_mappings.typed_transform: current iff a current LAI entry is recorded (takes precedence); previous iff past LAI use without current use; considering iff never treated with an LAI; else unknown_incomplete. Prior use of another agent never establishes candidate tolerability. No dose or administration-date values are read.

review.assumptions: see review.json unresolved_assumptions; reference tables synthetic; catalog binding provisional; both-usage rationale proposed

reviewed_result_mapping: indication and choice posteriors rendered as review distributions only; the maximum posterior never selects a product; choice presented only when indication present without refusal/current-LAI individualized review, otherwise deferred or suppressed at recommendation level with safety/delivery/discussion findings still visible; deterministic pointers from saved inputs shown first and never wait for LLM; unknown_disclosure and ddi_pointer always appended; needs_clarification branch on required missing/conflict
